If you work for a nonprofit, you should have the same access to retirement investment options those in the private sector enjoy. I am proud to champion legislation to fix this problem by creating parity.

Yesterday I reiterated my commitment to work with Banking Chairman @SenatorTimScott to find a pathway forward for my bipartisan Retirement Fairness for Charities and Educational Institutions Act.

The FBI’s National Counter-Unmanned Training Center (NCUTC) at Redstone Arsenal is the first of its kind and is playing a central role in training our federal, state, and local law enforcement officers in combatting the evolving threats of drones. This is particularly critical ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, America 250 celebrations, and the 2028 Summer Olympics. Grateful for the support from the Trump Administration in advancing our national security by supporting this program.

Common sense finally wins in Washington! For months I’ve been fighting alongside @SenJohnKennedy to stop Senators from being paid when they fail to fund the government.

We got it done today.

Social media companies know that the earlier they get our children addicted, the more likely our kids are to be lifetime users and the more money their companies will make. We have to keep fighting for accountability because Big Tech will always put their profits over our children and teens.

We used to think locking our doors at night meant our children were safe but today, the dangers are right in the palm of our kids’ hands.

Grateful for the brave parents who continue sharing their stories and honoring their children by pushing for change and accountability online.

Confirmed, 54-45: Confirmation of Executive Calendar #727, Kevin Warsh, of Florida, to be Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System for a term of four years.
